LanguageData.LP_DeathknightPlate.label: death knight armor
LanguageData.LP_DeathknightPlate.description: Blackened iron-grey plate armor with upturned jagged spikes on the pauldrons, a small skull ornament on the left shoulder and eerie green light seeping through a crack in the breastplate; a black cloak torn into strips on the back (takes the cape layer). Armor 110% of vanilla plate armor; cold damage -20%; enemies attacking the wearer in melee each have a 10% chance to become frightened (not minotaurs, loxodons or the psychically immune). Non-undead wearers get mood -3 ("the cold armor whispers"). Can only be forged by a lich at the necromantic ritual table (steel 150 + 200 phylactery sacrifice XP).\n\nSet "Death Knight" (armor + revenant great helm): when downed, "rises again" with 30% health, once every 3 days; doesn't trigger when worn by the lich themself.
LanguageData.LP_HelmRestlessDead.label: revenant great helm
LanguageData.LP_HelmRestlessDead.description: A black iron full helm with two swept-back horns on the forehead, a visor shaped like skull teeth and two points of eerie green in the eye slits. A heavy full helm, mind resistance +10%. Can only be forged by a lich at the necromantic ritual table (steel 50 + 80 phylactery sacrifice XP).
LanguageData.LP_CrownOfBone.label: bone crown
LanguageData.LP_CrownOfBone.description: A thin black iron circlet with five polished finger bones standing up in front and a purple gem in the middle. Social impact +10%; when worn by a lich, fear gaze range +1 cell. Can only be made by a lich at the necromantic ritual table (gold 20 + human leather 10).
